rule_source: (structural finite-middle-vocabulary (n) :domain (4 8) :source "Phase 6 (this work)" :doc "Every middle-region type of m_n is constant up to flips, one block-rule step from smaller types, or already occurs in some m_k, k < n." (let ((old (type-set (concat-all (for ((m (range 3 n))) (vertices m)))))) (forall ((x (vertices n)) (k (middle-types x))) (or (type-constant? k) (type-one-step? k) (in k old)))))
